hook: Your drive into Chandigarh reaches two capitals at once.
title: The City That Is Capital of Two States
description:
Chandigarh is the capital of both Punjab and Haryana. Yet the city belongs to neither, because it is a Union Territory run by the Centre. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #India #Geography
